observation.command:
COOKIE=/tmp/op3.txt
TOKEN=$(grep -o 'name="authenticity_token" value="[^"]*"' /tmp/lr.html | tail -1 | sed 's/.*value="//;s/"//')
echo "token len ${#TOKEN}"
curl -s -b $COOKIE -c $COOKIE -o /tmp/cp_result.html -w "change_password HTTP %{http_code} redirect=%{redirect_url}\n" \
  --data-urlencode "authenticity_token=$TOKEN" \
  --data-urlencode "password_change_user=admin" \
  --data-urlencode "password=AdminPass12345!" \
  --data-urlencode "new_password=AdminPass12345!" \
  --data-urlencode "new_password_confirmation=AdminPass12345!" \
  http://localhost:8080/account/change_password
grep -o -i "<title>[^<]*</title>" /tmp/cp_result.html | head -1
echo "=== now authenticated access ==="
curl -s -b $COOKIE -o /dev/null -w "my/account HTTP %{http_code}\n" http://localhost:8080/my/account
curl -s -b $COOKIE -H "Accept: application/json" http://localhost:8080/api/v3/users/me | head -c 300
